question: Should Workspaces expose preview as a distinct persisted builtin, or should reload and viewport controls extend the existing iframe-embed capability?
rationale: Both widgets embed the same policy-approved URL under the same sandbox, so choosing two public widget kinds versus one configurable capability is a product and long-term schema decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Consolidate the embed path
options.body: Add optional preview controls to iframe-embed or a shared canonical renderer, avoiding a parallel persisted widget kind.

options.title: Sponsor a distinct preview builtin
options.body: Keep preview separate only with an explicit product distinction, shared security/rendering helpers, and documented schema behavior.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the embed path
recommendation.body: Add optional preview controls to iframe-embed or a shared canonical renderer, avoiding a parallel persisted widget kind.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposal and related Workspaces design context, although final product acceptance still requires repository-owner review.
